How long does set up take?
Slang AI requires less than 30 minutes of your time to set up and can go live the very same day.
Slang AI is an AI-powered virtual agent that greets your callers as a human would. It instantly answers common questions and immediately forwards callers to a human when needed.
You can choose from dozens of state-of-the-art digital voices to power your Slang AI virtual assistant.
What happens when Slang AI can’t answer a caller’s question?
If a question is not recognized, Slang AI will automatically forward to a human or text a link with your email and other contact information (you can customize this).
What happens to my phone number?

We provide you with a new phone number to put on your website and your Google Business Profile. You can request either a local or a toll-free number. It’s also possible to keep your existing number, but you should discuss your options with our onboarding team.
